name: lead-quality-none-called
about: LQ3c: a young campaign whose leads nobody has called yet: no share of the called, no minutes to the first call, one lead that missed a hard requirement.

output.headline: 2 campaigns ran on November 3, 2026, spending $284.25 across 14,600 impressions and 203 clicks to deliver 7 leads at a $40.61 cost per lead.
points: Regional Class A — Joliet led the day with 6 leads at $30.75 cost per lead on $184.50 spend, a 1.5% click rate, and 141 clicks from 9,120 impressions. Dedicated night runs brought 1 lead at $99.75 cost per lead on $99.75 spend.
In November 2026, $612.30 has been spent on Meta with 28 days left in the month.

Lead quality over the last 14 days: Regional Class A — Joliet had 4 leads but nobody has been called yet, so there is no median time to first call. 1 of those leads — 25.0% of all the campaign's leads — missed a hard requirement on their own form, which is worth watching as call attempts begin.

The 2026-09-21 cohort (38 leads) reached a hire rate of 10.5% and a contacted rate of 86.8%; the 2026-09-28 cohort (40 leads) reached 12.5% hired and 90.0% contacted. Both are mature and tracking closely.
The 2026-10-26 cohort has 12 leads — 9 contacted and 3 converted so far — but it is too young to judge rates.
Qualified leads and leads lost before converting to applicants are not recorded in the system.
